scenario: rounded per subtotal, a net line and a gross line of one class are taxed in groups of their own
source: tax rounding mode rule: per subtotal, lines are grouped by tax class and by amount basis
note: A net amount has tax added and a gross amount has it taken out, so the two cannot be summed into one amount to tax: taxed as one net group, the gross line would be charged 2.40 of tax on top of its 12.00.
